Win BIG with WOOFi and Binance Web3 Wallet

Download the Binance Web3 Wallet and use WOOFi to split a $100,000 WOO airdrop!

A WOO airdrop arises

Binance has kindly featured WOOFi front and center in its brand new Web3 Wallet, and we’re celebrating with one of the biggest airdrops in WOO history! The premise is simple: download the Binance Web3 Wallet and complete tasks on WOOFi to earn WOO. The more tasks you complete, the more WOO you’ll get. Capiche?

Here’s a quick look at the different tasks:

Campaign timeline: 23.01.2024 00:00 UTC to 05.02.2024 23:59 UTC

Getting started

Start by downloading the Binance Web3 Wallet here. Once done, head to WOOFi’s designated page inside the wallet and click [Join Now]. You can complete the tasks in any order you like, just remember to click [Verify] on the campaign page once each action has been completed to lock in your guaranteed share of each prize pool.

Looking for a friendly guide on how to complete each task? Look no further than our GitBook which breaks down each activity step by step. We’ll also be sharing quick 1-minute video tutorials for each task on WOOFi’s Twitter throughout the week, so make sure to follow us to stay up-to-date!

Reward distribution

WOO tokens will be airdropped into all eligible wallet addresses within two weeks of the campaign’s end. Users will be able to view their airdrop by navigating to Discover > Airdrop Zone > Rewards > Details. So what are you waiting for? Download the Binance Web3 Wallet now and make sure you get some of the 256,000 WOO up for grabs!
